During the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], a '''plantation''' run by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Klatooine/Legends|Klatooine]] hired agents to "steal" the plantation's [[Klatooine paddy frog/Legends|paddy frog]] harvest and sell it at a higher price, thus allowing the plantation owners to charge more without angering other Hutts.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=crewskill|Underworld Trading|Price Hop}}</ref>
